title: Q14
description:
“They will perish, but You remain… You are the same, and Your years will not fail.”
Read: Psa 102:25–28, Isa 51:6, Heb 12:26–28
a) Psa 102:28 continues: “The children of Your servants will continue.” What does this bring forward for those who belong to the unchanging Son when the heavens are changed?
